labs.title: Manage Microsoft 365 groups, Teams, and shared mailboxes
labs.summary: Create a private Microsoft 365 group with a connected team, choose the right group object types, and delegate a shared mailbox by least privilege.
labs.scenario: Contoso is starting Project Phoenix. In the **simulated Microsoft 365 admin center**, create a private Microsoft 365 group, connect it to Microsoft Teams, review guest and external sender settings, and create a shared mailbox for contract questions. Done means the workspace is not public and only the two project leads can open and send as the shared mailbox.
learningObjectives: Choose between Microsoft 365 groups, security groups, distribution lists, and shared mailboxes
Create a private Microsoft 365 group with owners, members, and a connected team
Grant shared mailbox Read and manage and Send as permissions by least privilege
Review guest and external sender settings for a collaboration group
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with Microsoft 365 admin center navigation

steps.title: Create the private Microsoft 365 group
steps.instruction: Open **Teams & groups > Active teams & groups**, select **Add Microsoft 365 group**, and create **Project Phoenix** with owners **Alex** and **Miriam**, members **Jordan** and **Nina**, **Private** privacy, and **Add Microsoft Teams to your group** turned on.
steps.hint: Use the Microsoft 365 group wizard. Do not add Finance or all users.
steps.explanation: A Microsoft 365 group is the collaboration object behind Teams, a group mailbox, calendar, and connected SharePoint workspace. Private membership avoids accidental tenant-wide access.

rules.description: Project Phoenix is private and Teams-connected
rules.failureFeedback: Create Project Phoenix as a private Microsoft 365 group and add Teams.

rules.description: Owners and members are scoped correctly
rules.failureFeedback: Use Alex and Miriam as owners and Jordan and Nina as members.

steps.title: Review guest and external sender settings
steps.instruction: Open **Project Phoenix > Settings**. Keep **Guest access** as **Guests must be approved** and keep **Let people outside the organization email this group** turned off. Select **Save**.
steps.hint: External participation should be approved and intentional.
steps.explanation: Guest and external sender settings define collaboration boundaries. Review them before people start using the group.

rules.description: Project Phoenix external settings are reviewed
rules.failureFeedback: Keep guests approval-gated and external senders off.

steps.title: Compare Microsoft 365 object types
steps.instruction: Open **Compare group types**. Choose **Microsoft 365 group** for a project workspace, **Security group** for resource access, and **Distribution list** for announcements.
steps.hint: A shared mailbox is for a common mailbox; a distribution list is only broadcast mail.
steps.explanation: Choosing the wrong object creates governance gaps: distribution lists do not secure resources, and security groups do not provide Teams collaboration workloads.

rules.failureFeedback: Map collaboration, access, and broadcast mail to the right objects.

steps.title: Create the shared mailbox
steps.instruction: Open **Teams & groups > Shared mailboxes**, select **Add a shared mailbox**, and create **Project Phoenix Contracts** with email alias **project-phoenix-contracts**.
steps.hint: A shared mailbox is a functional address monitored by multiple people.
steps.explanation: The mailbox is separate from the group because it represents a contract address with mailbox-specific delegation.

rules.description: Project Phoenix Contracts shared mailbox exists
rules.failureFeedback: Create the shared mailbox with the requested name and alias.

steps.title: Delegate mailbox access by least privilege
steps.instruction: On **Project Phoenix Contracts**, grant **Read and manage** and **Send as** only to **Alex** and **Miriam**. Select **Save**.
steps.hint: Read and manage does not include Send as; configure both permission types.
steps.explanation: Shared mailbox delegation should be explicit. Granting all project members Send as would let too many people impersonate the mailbox address.

rules.description: Mailbox delegation is limited to project leads
rules.failureFeedback: Grant both permissions only to Alex and Miriam.

steps.title: Verify the collaboration design
steps.instruction: Return to **Active teams & groups** and **Shared mailboxes** to verify the group, team, privacy, guest settings, and mailbox delegation.
steps.hint: The final state should show a private Teams-connected group and a delegated shared mailbox.
steps.explanation: Final verification catches over-permissioning before users collaborate or Copilot can surface overshared data.

rules.successFeedback: The group and mailbox design is ready.
rules.failureFeedback: Complete the group, settings, comparison, and delegation tasks.

finalRules.description: Only project leads have mailbox delegation
finalRules.failureFeedback: Remove extra users from Read and manage and Send as.

finalRules.description: Project uses a private Teams-connected Microsoft 365 group
finalRules.failureFeedback: Use a private Microsoft 365 group with Teams and external senders off.

labs.solution:
1. Open **Teams & groups > Active teams & groups** and select **Add Microsoft 365 group**.
2. Create **Project Phoenix** with owners **Alex** and **Miriam**, members **Jordan** and **Nina**, alias `project-phoenix`, **Private** privacy, and **Add Microsoft Teams to your group** turned on.
3. In **Project Phoenix > Settings**, keep **Guest access** as **Guests must be approved**, keep **Let people outside the organization email this group** off, and select **Save**.
4. Open **Compare group types** and choose **Microsoft 365 group**, **Security group**, and **Distribution list** for the three scenarios.
5. Open **Shared mailboxes**, create **Project Phoenix Contracts** with alias `project-phoenix-contracts`.
6. Set **Read and manage** and **Send as** to **Alex** and **Miriam** only.
7. Verify the private Teams-connected group and least-privilege mailbox delegation.
